# Kryil Infotech Private Limited

> Kryil Infotech is a software engineering company based in Bangalore, India. It builds applied AI systems, data platforms and enterprise software, including NextDOOH cloud digital signage.

This is a public navigation summary for assistants and other readers. Consult the linked pages for current service scope, product requirements and commercial terms. This file is not an API specification or permission to submit enquiries or operate accounts.

## Company

- [Kryil home](https://kryil.com/): Company overview, applied AI and data engineering positioning, and contact information.
- [Brand](https://kryil.com/brand): Published company identity and approved brand assets.
- [News](https://kryil.com/news): Company announcements.
- [Blog](https://kryil.com/blog): Engineering articles and explanations. Concept-stage articles are not evidence of a shipped product or tested capability.
- [Careers](https://kryil.com/careers): Current published opportunities and application instructions; do not infer that an unlisted role is open.

## Services

- [Applied AI and machine learning](https://kryil.com/services/aimlservices): Applied AI engineering, retrieval systems, document processing and model deployment.
- [Data and database engineering](https://kryil.com/services/database): Data platforms, database administration and development.
- [Enterprise software](https://kryil.com/services/enterprise-solutions): Enterprise application development.
- [Cloud and professional services](https://kryil.com/services/professional-services): Published infrastructure and engineering services.
- [Security engineering](https://kryil.com/services/cybersecurity): Published security service scope.
- [Automation](https://kryil.com/services/automation): Published automation services.

The project scope, hosting environment, compatibility, price and delivery schedule are agreed with the team for each engagement. Do not infer certifications, client endorsements, measured outcomes or delivery promises from a list of services.

## NextDOOH product

- [NextDOOH on Kryil](https://kryil.com/products/nextdooh): Product overview and relationship to Kryil.
- [NextDOOH website](https://nextdooh.com/): Cloud digital signage software for managing screen content, playlists and schedules.
- [NextDOOH public information index](https://nextdooh.com/llms.txt): Product documentation and evaluation links.
- [NextDOOH demo and quote enquiries](https://nextdooh.com/contact): Discuss the screen count, locations, hardware and requirements for a proposed deployment.

Kryil is the company; NextDOOH is its digital signage product. Neither website describes Kryil as a manufacturer of drones, aircraft or military hardware. An engineering concept article does not establish a product offering.
